thread:
ana (People Ops): quick follow-up from today's all-hands about hiring strategy and cost buckets. saw a couple questions in the live Q about freezes vs prioritization so dropping the answers here.
devon (Eng): heard rumor of a freeze on IC L3 hires. true?
pat (Recruiting): short answer: no blanket freeze. we're prioritizing where new headcount lands. there will be fewer low-impact junior external hires this quarter unless tied to clear ramp metrics.
maya (Finance): to add: we set an overall headcount target for Q, and each org has a spending envelope. unused budget in one org doesn't automatically migrate to another without approval.
devon (Eng): so how do we request extra budget? will managers need exec signoff?
ana (People Ops): small correction, it's ana. process: submit the short form (link in the deck) -> recruiting triage -> hiring committee (People Ops + Eng + Finance) scores. large requests >2 FTEs need exec OK.
pat (Recruiting): also note: contractors and temps are judged differently. for short-term capacity we may use contractor slots that don't count vs headcount, but they still require budget signoff.
hiring-bot: [automated] hiring form opens: https://redwood/hiring-form  | deadline: Fri 5pm PT
devon (Eng): what about internal moves? i have two folks wanting to switch into product pods. will that block new reqs?
ana (People Ops): internal transfers are prioritized. If a transfer leaves a backfill need, that backfill will be considered within the originating org's envelope first. transfers that are lateral and mission-critical usually don't consume net new headcount.
own (CTO): important note: for infra/runtime roles we are prioritizing candidates with production latency/scale experience. expect the committee to weight that heavily.
devon (Eng): is there any change to interview rubric or hiring bar checks because of prioritization?
pat (Recruiting): rubrics the same, but add 1 brief note in the scorecard about "expected 3-month impact". that'll help committee triage.
maya (Finance): about offers in flight: if Recruiting has an accepted verbal and we're waiting on a slot, prioritize approvals to avoid losing candidates. contact me or ana and we'll expedite.
own (CTO): another thing: sales-commitments that trigger Dedicated bookings will unlock additional platform hires. ops will annotate those credits in the tracker.
devon (Eng): relocation budget? some candidates expect full relocation packages. are we capping that?
ana (People Ops): relocation remains on a case-by-case basis; committee may request capped allowances for standard roles. exceptions for senior hires or critical roles require leadership signoff.
pat (Recruiting): final note: the hiring tracker will be updated nightly. managers, please keep candidate stages current so we can make fast decisions.
ana (People Ops): i'll post the hiring-tracker link and a short FAQ in #all-hands later today. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
